data.title: Saudi Arabia Affirms Houthi Attacks on Oil Facilities Hinder Yemen's Exports, Deprive Its People of Vital Resources
data.content:
New York, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia has warned against exploiting natural resources to fund violence and prolong conflicts, calling for intensified international cooperation to combat the illicit trade of such resources and to protect energy infrastructure, maritime corridors, and supply chains.
    This came in a statement delivered by Acting Chargé d’Affaires of Saudi Arabia's Permanent Mission to the United Nations in New York Faris Al-Otaibi, during a UN Security Council session on natural resources and conflict.
    The Kingdom emphasized the importance of respecting states' sovereignty over their own resources, while promoting transparency and accountability to ensure populations benefit from the revenues generated. It noted that Houthi attacks on oil facilities have hindered Yemen's exports and deprived its people of vital economic resources.
    The Kingdom also highlighted its efforts—under Saudi Vision 2030—to manage resources sustainably and diversify the economy, underscoring the significance of international partnerships in addressing the root causes of conflict and promoting stability.
    -- SPA
